end.parentNote: Arjun practised converting distances to the same unit before comparing them and correctly ordered a set of mixed-unit distances. They explained that 2 km is 2000 m and therefore greater than 500 m. Subtraction caused some confusion; they later reached 500 m for 2,100 − 1,600, but this was not fully confirmed.
